information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website.** ​ * All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events. ​ * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. * Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue. ​ * We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called. ​ * Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations. ​ * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. ​ * Participants must bring their own cubes.
